claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

SU(5) matter consists of three bar5 and 10 families plus one fermionic adjoint24; scalars5H,24H,45H. Source45 has two antisymmetric upper and one lower fundamental tensor index with vanishing trace: Dynkin [0,1,0,1]; bar5=[0,0,0,1],10=[0,1,0,0],24=[1,0,0,1]. Scalar5 and45 are complex. Source extra24 fermion is one independent adjoint Weyl, not its SM decomposition counted again.

source_descriptions.reason: 24H field reality condition not independently established in inspected definition; real-type irrep alone is insufficient to choose one real versus one complex scalar. Preserve rather than guess.
